<!-- Generated by make site-ref (scripts/sitegen) from wdx itself: do not edit. -->

Read when wdx starts; an invalid one fails every command. The home is read from the environment, the rest from &lt;home&gt;/config.yaml, where log.level is written as "log: {level: debug}". wdx setting list shows them, and wdx setting set changes one and has the daemon apply it at once; after editing the file by hand, run wdx daemon restart. wdx setting write lists every setting in the file, as wdx update does with a new release's.

`--no-input` and `--color` override no\_input and color for one command. NO\_COLOR set to anything, or TERM=dumb, turns color off where it is auto.

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home` (`WDX_HOME`) | `/home/you/.wdx` | directory holding the config file, database, logs and cloned projects |
| `no_input` | `false` | never prompt, as `--no-input` does: true or false |
| `color` | `auto` | color text output: auto (only on a terminal, unless NO\_COLOR is set), always or never |
| `log.level` | `info` | lowest level logged: debug, info, warn, error |
| `log.retention_days` | `7` | days of log files kept besides today's |
| `otel.endpoint` | `http://localhost:4318` | OpenTelemetry collector the daemon sends its metrics to over OTLP/HTTP, such as the one wdx observe starts; empty sends none |
| `otel.interval_seconds` | `15` | seconds between two sends of the metrics |
| `update.channel` | `stable` | releases wdx update installs: stable, or dev for the newest release of either kind |
| `update.base_url` | `https://github.com/srjn45/wdx/releases/download` | where wdx update downloads releases, laid out as GitHub Releases; file://&lt;repo&gt;/dist for local builds |
| `terminal.shell` |  | absolute path of the shell terminals run; empty runs the user's login shell, /bin/sh when the system names none |
| `terminal.history_lines` | `100000` | lines of each terminal's history kept on disk, which wdx terminal attach scrolls back through; 0 keeps none, since terminal output can hold secrets |
| `terminal.history_tail` | `1000` | lines of a terminal's history wdx terminal history prints when not told how many; at most 10000 |
| `editor` | `vi` | terminal editor tide edits a file with: vi, vim, nvim, nano, hx, emacs |
| `tide.section_order` | `awdpc` | the sections tide's left pane shows, in their order, a letter each: a agents, w worktrees, d docs, p plans, c code; those left out are hidden |
| `tide.theme` | `slate` | the theme of colors tide paints its panes in: slate, for a dark terminal, is the only one so far; with color off tide paints none |
| `context.threshold.warning` | `200000` | tokens in an agent's context from which tide and wdx agent show its size as a warning, in yellow, and below which in green; a whole number below context.threshold.critical |
| `context.threshold.critical` | `400000` | tokens in an agent's context from which tide and wdx agent show its size as critical, in red; a whole number above context.threshold.warning |
| `docs.git_path` |  | directory of each project's repository, relative to its main checkout, that the daemon keeps the project's docs written into, read-only, on every change, as wdx doc sync-to-git does once; empty for none |
| `plan.parallel` | `3` | the most tasks each plan runs at once, each an agent in a worktree of its own, unless wdx plan run `--parallel` says otherwise; from 1 to 20 |
| `aca.claude_code.enabled` | `true` | whether new agents may run claude\_code, when it is installed: true or false |
| `aca.antigravity.enabled` | `true` | whether new agents may run antigravity, when it is installed: true or false |
| `aca.cursor.enabled` | `true` | whether new agents may run cursor, when it is installed: true or false |
| `aca.codex.enabled` | `true` | whether new agents may run codex, when it is installed: true or false |

`wdx setting list` shows each setting's value and where it came from; `wdx setting set --name <key> --value <value>` changes one in `~/.wdx/config.yaml`. See [`wdx setting`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/setting/).
